sloka: सरिताम् शरणम् गत्वा समतीयाय सागरम् ।संभ्रमात् परिवृत्त ऊर्मी रुद्ध मीन महोरगः ॥३-५४-९॥
transliteration: saritām śaraṇam gatvā samatīyāya sāgaram ।saṁbhramāt parivṛtta ūrmī ruddha mīna mahoragaḥ ॥3-54-9॥

translations.english: While Sita, princess of Videha was being carried away, the ocean, abode of Varuna got bewildered, waves rolled back, the movement of big serpents and fishes stopped.
